title.narrative: Integrated Natural Resources and Environmental Management Project

description.narrative: The project will address unsustainable watershed management in four priority river basins of the country. The project will be implemented as a sector loan to institutionalize effective watershed management regimes in four upper river basins (URBs) that can be replicated across the country. The four URBs are (i) Chico River Basin in Cordillera Administrative Region (CAR), Northern Luzon island, (ii) Wahig-Inabanga on the island of Bohol, (iii) Lake Lanao Basin in the Autonomous Region of Muslim Mindanao (ARMM) and Upper Bukidnon River Basin in Bukidnon (the latter two on the island of Mindanao).

Progress Toward Outcome: Delayed. Operationalization of the income generating activities under Output 2 started early 2020. Start of income assessment is affected by the COVID-19 travel restriction.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Mar 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/41220/41220-013-apfs-en_5.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Mar 2021: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/41220/41220-013-iee-en_58.pdf
Some results are in the Safeguards Due Diligence Reports | Nov 2019: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/41220/41220-013-sddr-en_2.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Jul 2022: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/41220/41220-013-smr-en_3.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: 1a. Indicative development plans for the Chico and Wahig-Inabanga URBs were adopted by the local government unit (equivalent to around 598,614 ha).
1b. 57 out of 81 LGUs adopted the watershed management and investments plans.
1c.a GIS based database, including remote sensing information for performance monitoring established and operationalized.
1d. All the 24 watershed management councils were created under the project of which only 28% members are women.
2a. As of Jun 2020, around 79,430 ha effectively protected through community-based monitoring in four URBs.
2b. 22,2486 ha. Rehabilitated through reforestation and assisted natural regeneration.
2c. 14,307 ha. of agroforestry with community participation and 3,564 ha of commercial plantation established.
2d. 3,471 ha of conservation farming demonstration established.
2e. Income-enhancing small-scale infrastructure improvements completed 47.36 kms of rural
access, 1.1 km of foot trails, and 1 provincial trading center. Awarding for communal irrigation
and potable water supply (level II spring development) schemes pending issuance of water permits.
2f. 12% of the local labor for infrastructure is occupied by local rural women.
2g. 218 DENR-LED LES packages were signed with POs and 162 are operationalized. 51 DTI-led LES are with ongoing procurement until Q3 2020.
3a. 34,028 local beneficiaries trained (PO members, LGUs, DENR staff).
3b. 309 barangays capacitated across the four (4) project sites.
3c. 19 community watershed protection brigades organized and strengthened.
4. Project management and support services contracted and ongoing.
Tenders and Contracts Awarded: https://www.adb.org/projects/41220-013/main#project-tenders
